==Description==
'''Sea Turtle''' is an emote that could have been obtained at Level 34 of the regular [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]]. It was made by Capra. It is looped and moveable, but not interactable. No music can be heard while performing the emote.

'''Sea Turtle''' makes a turtle appear, which the player's character jumps on. This allows them to surf using the turtle.

It has a cost of {{BeachBalls|1,190}} or {{Robux|126}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{BeachBalls|19,030}} or {{Robux|2,923}}. This item also has had two other costs. First one was the cost before its 20% discount, which had a cost of {{Robux|158}} with a total cost of {{Robux|3,672}}. The second was the price prior to the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] individual skip cost fix, where it had a cost of {{Robux|98}}, with a total cost of {{Robux|2,810}}.
